purpose: The Notification Service sends emails, SMS, and push messages to customers when events occur, such as payments, transfers, or card blocks.

components.name: notifier
components.evidence: the service that decides what to send and sends it.

components.name: domain-events (Kafka)
components.evidence: the stream on which the other services publish what happened.

components.name: Email and SMS provider
components.evidence: the external company that delivers the messages.

flows.evidence: A service publishes an event on domain-events, or calls the API directly for a message that is not tied to an event.
The message goes to the provider; the provider answers later with delivered, bounced or failed, and the notifier updates the status.
The vendor reports delivery results by calling a webhook of ours.
